recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the missing computable portion of the published decision and remains compatible with URN canonical URLs such as urn:oid: and urn:uuid:.
issue_request: FHIR-27789 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and requested that FHIR-core clearly state/enforce that canonical URLs are absolute, with CanonicalResource.url using a regex that requires ':' in addition to the no-spaces URI baseline.
initial_application: Commit 356b6a87ae applied part of the issue by changing CanonicalResource.url's short description to say absolute URI, while the definition already said absolute URI. Commit 5c702608fa for FHIR-30697 later added the cnl-1 invariant to CanonicalResource.url and inherited URL elements, but that invariant only excluded '|', '#', and spaces and still allowed relative values without a colon.
additional_context: FHIR-I WGM 202101 minutes confirm the intended rule: canonicals must be absolute URIs rather than relative URLs, OID URNs remain valid, and the regex should require a colon. Current datatypes narrative already says canonical URLs are never relative, and no later source/history evidence showed a reversal.
reconciliation: Updated CanonicalResource.url and active canonical-resource URL element definitions carrying cnl-1 to require a URI scheme and colon with the regex ^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9+.-]*:[^|# ]*$ while preserving the existing exclusions for '|', '#', and spaces. Also aligned stale concrete-resource short descriptions from URI to absolute URI where they inherit the CanonicalResource canonical URL semantics.
source_changes: Updated source/canonicalresource/structuredefinition-CanonicalResource.xml cnl-1 to require an absolute URI scheme/colon.
Updated 30 active implementing canonical resource StructureDefinition URL elements to use the same cnl-1 regex and align stale short descriptions with the absolute-URI rule.
